The structure designated '''Vault S-86''' by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] was a [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] vault constructed by the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] in what would later be known as the [[High Security Section]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], Republic [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] under [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Gantrell]] stored weapons developed during their research into the [[Central power core|prison's power core]] in Vault S-86, and a group of [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] [[Prison/Legends|prisoners]] attempted to steal the weapons before they were stopped by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]].
